game_concept: A action defense set in The Kingdom – Village Green, the green outside the walls: the squire must handle rogue knights while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Memory Map: Place variable cards on a memory board so the throne reads the right value at run time.
theme: The Kingdom – Village Green: the green outside the walls
core_gameplay_loop: In Village Green, repeat each round: Place variable cards on a memory board so the throne reads the right value at run time. Each round, rogue knights strike the throne, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the y value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the throne from rogue knights in Village Green: keep the y meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: y drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 6 (applied tier): Memory Map
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how y changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue knights in Village Green.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 36 seconds while y > 0.
